player_input: Если вы свободны мы можем поговорить сейчас.
scene_summary: Shiki accepts Kabuto private discussion now in Konoha arena medical wing. Kabuto passes Aki chart to nurse, arranges continued observation; Aki asks not to keep Shiki long, Ren stays with her. Kabuto steps to quiet alcove by window for discreet talk. Refers to observations Shiki previously reported: anomalous second Grass team registration, five exchanged looks and unexplained finger signal. He asks Shiki who else was told these specific observations, whether commission was informed and whether there is written testimony or only Kabuto knows full story. Does not confess nor confirm espionage. Awaits Shiki's voluntary answer. No new fact about official registration established.
